source.directorySummary: Implements the 'create' file/folder command — defining its dir/name arguments and folder/tree UI options, validating names and workspace containment, and adapting handler results to CLI or web tree responses.

adapter.ts.sourceSummary: Adapter trims and validates dir/name args, resolves workspace root, calls handleCreateCommand, and returns error text, 'Created <path>' for non-web, or renderTreeForWeb with alias/treeDir/ext/expanded/revealPath for web.

definition.ts.sourceSummary: Factory returns the 'create' SubcommandDefinition with required string args dir and name and options --folder, --tree-dir, --ext, and --expanded.

handler.ts.sourceSummary: Validates single-segment name, checks workspace containment and that the target directory exists and is a directory, then creates an empty file or folder or returns typed errors for escapes/exists.

summary.value: Implements the 'create' file/folder command — defining its dir/name arguments and folder/tree UI options, validating names and workspace containment, and adapting handler results to CLI or web tree responses.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Leaf creation endpoint within the commands file-operations family (create/delete/edit/rename/view/tree/search). Sits beneath the file plugin's centralized dispatcher (plugins/file/adapter.ts/handleFile) and registration (init.ts) aggregation at plugins/file/commands — invoked via dispatch fan-out, not directly. Completes the file lifecycle as the write-origin that sibling view/edit/delete/rename/tree commands subsequently operate on, sharing the validate-workspace-containment → execute filesystem → adapt to CLI/web pattern via shared workspace-root/path-validation and web tree rendering.

files.adapter.ts: Channel-adaptation boundary between dispatcher and domain logic — sanitizes dir/name args, resolves workspace root, delegates to handler, then maps typed success/error to CLI text ('Created <path>') or web tree UI (renderTreeForWeb with alias/treeDir/ext/expanded/revealPath). Implements the adapt phase of the file-command pattern shared with sibling file/git commands.
files.definition.ts: Declarative contract for discovery and dispatch — registers the create subcommand shape (required dir/name, --folder/--tree-dir/--ext/--expanded) for CLI and web tooling via the file plugin's SubcommandDefinition system. Pure schema with no validation or I/O, consumed by the parent container and dispatcher/help.
files.handler.ts: Isolated domain executor owning containment and filesystem invariants — validates single-segment name, verifies target directory exists/is-directory within workspace, and creates empty file or folder or returns typed escape/exists errors for the adapter to render. No CLI/web awareness; relies on shared validation.
